data.title: Super Tens and Ones Builder
data.description: Practice building two-digit numbers using base-ten rods and unit cubes to master place value.

challenges.hint: Look at the digits. The number 24 has 2 tens and 4 ones.
Remember that tens rods represent groups of ten, and unit cubes represent ones.
Check the tens place first to find out how many rods you need.
Sixty has six tens and zero ones. You will only need rods for this number!
Count out 8 ten-rods and 7 unit cubes to make 87.
